objective_value: <float> Expected total profit (revenue from electricity sales minus fuel, startup, and shutdown costs) across the scenario tree.
x: <dict, key: '{node_id}'> Sparse generation overrides by node.
y: <dict, key: '{node_id}'> Sparse commitment overrides by node.
u: <dict, key: '{node_id}'> Sparse startup overrides by non-root node.
